title: Physicists discover “astonishing” property of light that defies expectations
caption:
Physics just got a little weirder. Researchers discovered that light can spontaneously develop a spinning, twisting behavior as it travels through empty space—no lenses or mirrors required. By manipulating the light's internal geometry, scientists are unlocking new ways to control it for future tech.

Source: Sciencedaily - Physicists discover “astonishing” property of light that defies expectations
